policy: Read-only service audit. No service is disabled by a profile. SAFE_TO_DISABLE is intentionally empty; dependencies, edition, features, hardware, and user workflows are machine-specific.
notes: A label is a review hint, not a recommendation to stop or disable a service.
Services can be trigger-started, per-user, policy-managed, or required by a feature not visible in a simple service list.
Use Windows Services or the feature's own UI for any user-directed change; this tool does not apply service startup changes.
